name: In-scattering / Emittance Integral
definition: A discretized compositing scheme for computing in-scattered light using an emittance integral, implemented via progressive refinement with one direction per pass.
summary: The In-scattering / Emittance Integral estimates light scattered into a volume sample from local sources by discretizing the emittance integral into a compositing scheme, distinguishing itself from Local Ambient Occlusion by computing in-scattered and emissive light contributions rather than just shadowing.
